title: The bathroom I went into in my mall world
content: Just woke up have to do this while.dream is fresh. I feel like as I type I am forgetting. It had broken urinals with a blue urine cake on the ground..(I remember the weirdest dream details) . There was a smell and humming noise and there was an air vent with 2 blue strings on it? I guess to tell people if the air is working ? Beats me lol. I washed my hands wirh this sink. You step on the bottom and it's like communal so people can share a circle? Now I think about it ir feels evil to put children in a circle to wash hands. Nobody talked. Just children washing hands and myself too. Soap was that pink soap that has a weird smell and super cheap? But I couldn't figure out how to get the soap to come out..I never went to the bathroom I just washed my hands and felt like I had to...like I was dirty. The children were...uncanny . I was in elementary school in the 90s and this dream felt very nostalgic but surreal. It's like the photo but in dream it was all silver. Head to toe silver. Couldn't see kids eyes because they were all washing their hands looking down..almost in unison? It could be the hospice meds.. *now I am on hospice and have some mild delirium and im weak so pl3ase be kind with typos ..mentally im fine..not even depressed(as a patient no longer the provider..it sucks) and I'm taking some heavy pain meds and heavy benzos..but only the morphine gives me the vivid dreams which led me to my 2nd mall dream. First was too long ago to remember anything except am old yellow mall like others describe and empty and 1000% feeling of like dread or you're breaking a law hide typis. Love to all.
